frontmatter.name: rankmath-seo-wp
frontmatter.description: Write Rank Math SEO-compliant WordPress articles in Traditional Chinese (or any language). Outputs Gutenberg block-paste-ready HTML with HowTo/FAQ blocks, focus keyword density 1.0-1.5%, 12 H2 structure, and SEO Title containing a digit.
frontmatter.author: moksa (https://moksaweb.com)

loaderBehaviour: Gemini CLI supports the Agent Skills standard (same SKILL.md format as Claude Code). Place SKILL.md under .gemini/skills/<name>/ (project) or ~/.gemini/skills/<name>/ (global) and it auto-discovers on session start. References, tools, and data are copied alongside.
verificationNote: Verified against Gemini CLI as of July 2026. Older versions that predate SKILL.md support use the legacy extension path .gemini/extensions/rankmath-seo-wp/GEMINI.md — if skills are not picked up, install with --to .gemini/extensions/rankmath-seo-wp and rename SKILL.md to GEMINI.md.
